meta.note: Негативы не используются, как и в units.json: у моделей с cfg<=1 они не действуют вообще, а у qwen-image приор модели оказывается сильнее запрета. Всё, что было негативом, переформулировано утвердительно в части hard и поднято в начало промпта.
meta.assembly: Сборка из частей в порядке parts_order; порядок задан здесь один раз.
meta.frames_note: Здание несёт 7 кадров: Idle 1 + Active 4 + Damaged 1 + Rubble 1 (GDD §3.3). Концепт даёт силуэт и материал, все кадры и проекцию делает Blender на орто-риге.

shared.framing_building: The building is shown alone, centred, against a completely flat featureless dark grey backdrop. There is no ground surface beneath it and it casts no shadow. It is viewed orthographically from a three-quarter angle above, as a technical study rather than a scene, with no perspective convergence.
shared.style: The rendering is a sober, grim, utilitarian industrial design study: heavy plausible engineering, matte weathered surfaces, honest construction, the sensibility of a technical reference drawing. Lighting is flat and even with a soft key from the upper left, no dramatic contrast and no lens effects. Emissive accents stay small, a few pixels of the whole structure.

buildings.subject: A military command yard of an industrial successor-state army: a low, wide reinforced concrete bunker with heavily sloped outer walls and a flat roof deck, a broad armoured vehicle bay door set into one face.
buildings.hard: It is a single squat military structure, closed and windowless, standing empty with no vehicles, no people and no fences around it. An antenna mast and a small radar dish rise from the roof deck.
buildings.palette: Raw grey concrete and painted gunmetal steel: mid #39434E on the metalwork, pale #5C6874 on the upward-facing concrete, thin cyan #2FD8E0 light strips along the door frame, white stencilled markings on the walls.
buildings.detail: Pale ash dust has settled on the roof and in the wall seams.
